name: The Fool
description: The ring becomes Levellable, similar to a relic. Instead of upgrading it by sacrificing relics, it can be upgraded by sacrificing other rings.

name: The Magician
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that grants a 1/LR free casting of a random spell.

name: The High Priestess
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that is the first tier bonus from a random glyph path, empowered by another random tier from that same path. If you already have that glyph path, you instead gain an additional usage of it during its cooldown.

name: The Empress
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that is randomly chosen from a random relic.

name: The Emperor
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that is a randomly chosen passive from a random monster of CR up to your level.

name: The Hierophant
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that grants +2 to a random ability score and its maximum value.

name: The Lovers
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that is a randomly-chosen passive from a random crystal monster.

name: The Chariot
description: The ring has 1 additional affix of a chosen Affinity.

name: Justice
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that is of the same Affinity as a random affix this card's owner currently has equipped.

name: The Hermit
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that is a randomly chosen Knack from a random class.

name: Wheel of Fortune
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that has a minimum point value of 2 and is negated, then the top two cards in the tarot deck are added to the reading.

name: Strength
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that grants a 1/LR free usage of a random maneuver.

name: The Hanged Man
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that increases the base colour tier of a random loot result for you by 1.

name: Death
description: The ring becomes a permanent passive bonus, but your next loot roll crumbles into ash.

name: Temperance
description: The ring is not created. Instead, the other 2 cards from this reading are added to your next reading, which can have up to 4 cards total in it (allowing you to perform a reading with 2 new cards).

name: The Devil
description: The ring is crafted as if its reading contained an additional card, which is randomly chosen from all cards that are currently in the possession of players, including from this reading.

name: The Tower
description: The ring has 1 additional chaotic affix.

name: The Stars
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that you can define (DM will balance for max 3pts).

name: The Moon
description: The ring has 1 additional affix. Instead of applying to you, the affix is negated and applied to creatures of your choice within a 60' aura.

name: The Sun
description: The ring has 1 additional affix. Instead of applying to you, the affix is applied to creatures of your choice within a 60' aura.

name: Judgement
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that has a minimum point value of 6, but it is only applied to you after you go down for the first time between rests.

name: The World
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that grants a d6 expertise die in a random skill.

name: Ace of Wands
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that has either the Control or Accuracy Affinity. Draw a card from the Wands deck. If the card is numeric, it sets the minimum point value of this additional affix to half that value. Court cards add a further affix of the following Affinities: Control or Wealth (King), Survivability or Resource (Queen), Damage or Accuracy (Knight), or Mobility or Utility (Page).

name: Ace of Cups
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that has either the Mobility or Resource Affinity. Draw a card from the Cups deck. If the card is numeric, it sets the minimum point value of this additional affix to half that value. Court cards add a further affix of the following Affinities: Control or Wealth (King), Survivability or Resource (Queen), Damage or Accuracy (Knight), or Mobility or Utility (Page).

name: Ace of Swords
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that has either the Damage or Survivability Affinity. Draw a card from the Swords deck. If the card is numeric, it sets the minimum point value of this additional affix to half that value. Court cards add a further affix of the following Affinities: Control or Wealth (King), Survivability or Resource (Queen), Damage or Accuracy (Knight), or Mobility or Utility (Page).

name: Ace of Pentacles
description: The ring has 1 additional affix that has either the Wealth or Utility Affinity. Draw a card from the Pentacles deck. If the card is numeric, it sets the minimum point value of this additional affix to half that value. Court cards add a further affix of the following Affinities: Control or Wealth (King), Survivability or Resource (Queen), Damage or Accuracy (Knight), or Mobility or Utility (Page).
